data_json.name: Cycle of Rebirth
data_json.description: Allies heal 3 HP per round; fallen allies rise with 5 HP (temporary until stabilized at spell end). Enemies lose 3 HP per round (Transfer Life Force). Temporal suspension prevents immediate death checks during duration.
data_json.notes: • Revived allies return at 5 HP and function normally during duration. • At end of spell, revived allies must stabilize (save or fall dead again). • Enemies cannot resist Transfer drain except by leaving the zone. • Cycle visible as golden threads tying combatants together. • Spell strains caster’s body, leaving them exhausted after use.
data_json.flavorLine: “Death is but a pause in the great cycle.”

data_json.name: Vital Wellspring

durations.description: Combat Step (2 at Apprentice, expands with levels)

data_json.description: Healing, Buffs to vitality, Wards, Revival at top tiers
data_json.notes: • Apprentice: Restores 1 HP and grants +5% resilience for 1 combat step. • Novice: Heals 2 HP and cleanses poison/disease from one ally; duration = 1 Combat Round. • Master: Multi-Target (up to 3 allies), heals 3 HP each, grants +1 Constitution for 1 Combat Round. • High Master: AoE (Radius 20 ft), heals 5 HP per ally, wards against poison/disease/curse, duration = 1 Hour. • Grand Master: AoE (Sphere 100 ft), heals 10 HP per ally, restores lost Constitution, revives 1 fallen ally at 1 HP, wards all allies with +2 Constitution and curse immunity for 1 Day.
data_json.flavorLine: “A drop of life may close a wound. A river of life may turn the tide of worlds.”
